unit: Korg MS-20 (1978), Rev 1 (two KORG35 filters; KLM-127, KLM-128C, KLM-129); front panel as made 1978-83
source_note: Front view from the Commons studio photo (Nikon Z 7II, 28.5 mm), rectified with a lens-distortion + homography model fitted to the panel's own straight print and round tick rings, scaled by the service manual's 569 mm overall width (side panels' outer faces, parallax removed with the camera model). Independent check: the service manual's board front views (KLM-127 knob shafts, KLM-128C jacks) fit the result to 0.39 / 0.22 mm rms by a similarity, and their scales agree with each other and the width (panel.md section 1). Colours from the colour photos (Korg_MS-20.jpg, Zinnmann, CC BY-SA 3.0; SMEM Playroom, CC BY 4.0). Photos are reference only (private/ms20/docs/photos/SOURCES.md).
origin: top-left corner of the front view: x = 0 on the left side panel's outer face, y = 0 on the top cover's far edge as seen straight-on; x right, y down the panel face (down on screen); the keyboard below it in orthographic projection

official_dimensions_mm.note: service manual section 1, item 15-16 ("569(W) x 308(D) x 249(H) mm", "7.7 kgs")

key_plane.note: the white keys' top surface is a plane at 60.9 deg to the panel face (the panel leans back); keys are drawn in orthographic projection onto the panel plane, so their lengths are shortened by 0.487. black_rise (black key top above the white key top) is a standard-keyboard estimate.

accuracy: knob centres +-0.3 mm, jack centres +-0.25 mm (rms vs the service manual's boards 0.39 / 0.22 mm); printed legends, boxes, lines, ticks, numerals +-0.2 mm relative, +-0.4 mm absolute; scale +-0.4 % (569 mm spec, side-panel height +-2.5 mm); plate and lip edges +-0.3 mm; screws, plugs, LEDs +-0.5 mm; keyboard x +-1.5 mm, key lengths +-3 mm (standard 6.5 in octave assumed); left cheek, wheel and switch +-5 mm; knob heights and top diameters are estimates +-2 mm

top_cover.note: steel top cover seen end-on above the panel (master grey 33 against the panel's 46-96)

side_panel.note: black side panels, fine texture; SMEM #28282F

panel_paint.note: satin dark blue-grey panel paint; SMEM daylight #282A30 / #3E4453 / #363A46. The master is lit from above: grey 96 at the top to 46 at the bottom; draw it flat.

logo_grey.note: the KORG logotype is printed light grey, not white (SMEM #B4B8C1); used only for a blank logo place

nut_chrome.note: chrome hex nuts and bushings of the jacks; highlights #E0DFE0, mid #42495A

plug_black.note: trimmer access plugs, black plastic, slightly domed

cheek_black.note: keyboard cheeks and the key well

wheel_black.note: control wheel, black with grey rib highlights (SMEM #2E2C2B)

fonts.panel_title: Section titles: a Helvetica-style grotesque, condensed (closest free: Liberation Sans Narrow Regular, metric-compatible with Arial Narrow), white caps, cap height 3.00 mm, stroke 0.42 mm (FWHM, 14 % of the cap height), letter-spacing about 0.36 mm.
fonts.panel_legend: Control labels, dial numerals, jack names and voltage ranges: the same face, cap height 2.20 mm, stroke 0.30 mm.
fonts.panel_box: Text inside the patch panel's boxes: the same face, cap height 2.15 mm, left-aligned 1.6-2.2 mm in from the box line.
fonts.panel_small: The small two-line level marks (+5V/0V, +2.5V) and GND: the same face, cap height 1.90 mm.
fonts.panel_name: SYNTHESIZER under the logo: the same grotesque, not condensed as much, cap height 6.30 mm, stroke 0.78 mm.
fonts.fit: font_fit.py: over 69 one-word legends, Arial Narrow (= Liberation Sans Narrow) predicts the ink widths to 0.37 mm rms with x-scale 0.78 and 0.36 mm tracking, or 0.46 mm rms at x-scale 0.95 with no tracking; Helvetica/Arial need x-scale 0.65. Fit every legend to its measured bbox width.
fonts.substitute: Not in the repo: add Liberation Sans Narrow (SIL OFL 1.1) or Roboto Condensed (Apache 2.0). Already in the repo: IBM Plex Mono and JetBrains Mono (third_party/fonts), Michroma (machines/virusc/fonts): none is close.
fonts.logos: The KORG logotype is not drawn: its place (logo_maker, place maker) is filled from the user's artwork pack.

conventions.text: bbox = ink box (cap top to baseline, sub-pixel half-maximum edges); x,y = bbox centre; cap_h = capital height; stroke = FWHM of the vertical stems; align = how the legend sits on its control or box; text keeps double spaces where the print has a wide word gap
conventions.outline_box: bbox = stroke centre line of a square-cornered box
conventions.line: points = stroke centre polyline (Douglas-Peucker to 0.12 mm); kind rule = section rules and frames (0.6-1.1 mm), flow = the patch panel's signal lines (0.25-0.3 mm)
conventions.symbol: polylines = stroke centre lines of a printed glyph (wave shapes, ground marks); stroke = width; round joins
conventions.knob: x,y = shaft centre (the printed tick ring's centre); d = knob base (skirt) diameter, top_d = top, height (estimates); angles in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock; scale.tick_r = [inner, outer] radius of the printed ticks; numerals at radius r to the numeral's ink-box centre; pointer from min_deg to max_deg
conventions.rotary: as knob, with detents_deg and detent_legends (the printed symbol or numeral at each detent, in the plugin's choice order)
conventions.jack: x,y = centre of the opening; d = opening; nut_af = hex nut across flats; j = J number (service manual); io = in/out; legends = the print that belongs to it; in_patch_h = in core/patch.h
conventions.key: front view (orthographic projection onto the panel plane) of the key plane: bbox = visible top from the lip to the front edge; front_face = the front face below it; key 0 = C3 ... key 36 = C6 (plugin: MIDI 48-84; the unit's C-1 .. C-4); black keys on top of white keys
conventions.logo: artwork place: a box the hardware view leaves for the user's artwork file (place name in "place")
conventions.hole: trimmer access plug: a black plug in a panel hole

numeral_layouts.note: mean polar position (deg clockwise from 12 o'clock, r to the ink-box centre, mm) of each dial numeral over all dials with that scale; sd and n say how regular the print is
